purpose: Scientific validity map; reference website operational domain still unknown (B06).

IF97.critical: Some finite properties retained; singular derivatives unavailable
IF97.metastability: 273.15–273.16 K warning retained; separate metastable-vapor equation not implemented

IAPWS95.lower_boundary: R14-08 Ih lower pressure for T<273.16; III/V/VI upper pressure, pressure-dependent inversion; melting boundary excluded
IAPWS95.sub_triple_vapor: Not implemented: outside the validated range, requires explicit extrapolation policy
IAPWS95.critical: Exact Pc/Tc rejected; local convergence and phase certification still required

transport_ranges.pressure_intervals: Each lower pressure cutoff is open and each upper cutoff closed; p>0. Lower T is melting, or 273.16 K for vapor at p<0.000611657.
transport_ranges.IF97: Industrial versions inside the IF97 domain, up to 1173.15 K; 273.15–273.16 K metastability note retained.

property_map.availability: Scientific critical enhancement with IAPWS-95 reference derivative; independent mu range
Own lambda range; R15-11 auxiliary viscosity may be evaluated outside displayed mu validity
lambda/(rho*cp) with consistent SI conversion only if lambda available
mu*cp/lambda only in the intersection of both domains
238<=T<=873 K, p<=1000 MPa; IAPWS-95 density preferred. IF97 density variant explicitly noted.
273.16<=T<=647.096 K on a vapor–liquid interface; no sub-triple extrapolation. Equilibrium mixtures retain sigma, no averaged transport.
Stable fluid only, no ice or implicit extrapolation
Availability is per property and phase, never a shared pressure cap

mixtures: For 0<x<1, h/s/u/v use mass balance; cp/cv/derivatives/mu/nu/lambda/diffusivity/Pr/dc remain unavailable. sigma describes the interface.
numerical_policy: tests/fixtures/steam97-p05-reference.json; tolerances fixed before product evaluation. Numerical agreement is not physical measurement uncertainty.
limitations: IAPWS-95 higher derivatives can behave unphysically extremely near criticality (R6-95 §5); transport enhancement also has numerical limitations on the critical isotherm (R12-08/R15-11). Existing precision controls do not remove formulation limitations.
R14-08 rounded branch junction constants are used as published, with one-sided branch domains, without an invented smoothing curve.
Steam97Web help extrapolation claims (5000 K / 100000 MPa) are not accepted as validated ranges; actual website phase/property behavior still needs B06 evidence.
